title: How 10-Minute Delivery Became a Billion Dollar Idea | Zepto Case Study | Live Hindi
description:
This video is about "How 10-Minute Delivery Became a Billion Dollar Idea | Zepto Case Study | Live Hindi"

Zepto has become one of India’s biggest startup success stories. In this video, we deep dive into the Zepto success story, exploring how two college dropouts built a $7 billion startup and shocked the entire quick-commerce industry.
This is the real dropout to billionaire journey that every entrepreneur needs to learn from.

We break down the complete Zepto case study, the Zepto business model, and how their 10-minute delivery strategy helped them compete with giants like Blinkit and Swiggy Instamart.
From the early days of Zepto to its rise as a unicorn, this video explains how Zepto started, how the founders executed their vision, and what makes Zepto’s growth strategy so powerful.

In this detailed case study, you’ll learn:
How Zepto became a $7B startup
The mindset of Zepto founders
Zepto’s quick commerce strategy
Zepto vs Blinkit vs Instamart
The future of India’s quick commerce market

If you love Indian startup success stories, Zepto startup story, or a solid quick commerce case study, this video is for you.
